name: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Mountaineer Rockgar is looking for volunteers for a mission through Dun Algaz and into the Wetlands.

If you want to get your boots wet in that soggy county to the north, then speak with Rockgar at Dun Algaz.  Dun Algaz is north up the road, beyond the guard tower.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Hello, Champion! You're here for the scouting mission, are you? Very good!

I hope your gear is in good condition, because this "scouting" mission has changed into something more messy...

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 21, 1,420 XP in all.

quests.name: The Algaz Gauntlet
quests.objectiveText: Traverse Dun Algaz. Kill 8 Dragonmaw Scouts and 6 Dragonmaw Grunts. Report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.
